notes.title: Elemental Echoes Minor Patch
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where you would grab Rin as a party member but still be blocked from the pyramid. 

Fixed an issue some users had with the games exe file.

notes.title: Elemental Echoes Update!
notes.notes:
Fixed Audio Issue where Pyramid Boss room would not load proper audio file.

Updated some of the minor audio of some cutscenes thus fixing an issue where two background music pieces overlapped when introduced to Tyra.

Fixed some dialogue spelling between Tyra and future party member.
